statistical_limitation: This archive provides one pooled experiment per sample. Cell-level counts are not independent biological replicates. Profiles from unverified guide identities are exploratory only. Contrasts are generated only when both perturbation and negative-control mappings are explicitly verified. No inferential p-values, FDR values, or functional compensation labels are generated.
supervised_training_warning: Do not treat each guide identity as a supervised class with one pseudobulk profile. A single profile per guide does not provide independent within-class training/test examples. Cell-level random splits would risk leakage and pseudoreplication. Additional biological replicates or independent perturbation experiments are needed for defensible supervised generalization.
next_requirements: Resolve guide-to-target mappings from original supplementary guide annotations.
Verify negative controls before interpreting perturbation-versus-control contrasts.
Determine whether independent biological replicates exist in the study design.
Use replicate-aware pseudobulk differential expression if replicate data exist.
Obtain independent functional evidence before assigning compensation labels.
Do not train a supervised guide classifier from one pseudobulk profile per guide.
